'''Pelvear''' is a [[peddler]] who sells his wares around [[Almoth Plain]] and [[Toman Head]].
== History ==
Pelvear was being attacked by the [[Children of the Light]], who had disguised themselves as [[Tarabon]]er bandits to stoke up resentment in the local area. He was saved by [[Lorwyn Kilvar]] and his companions. Guards from [[House Antos]] later caught up to the group and asked if Lorwyn was present; Pelvear affirmed that Lorwyn was with him, being unaware of the man's distress about his arranged marriage.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
